title: 2018 Rose Bowl: Georgia 54, Oklahoma 48 in Double Overtime
question: What was the score of the 2018 Rose Bowl between Oklahoma and Georgia?
answer: Georgia beat Oklahoma 54-48 in double overtime on January 1, 2018, in a College Football Playoff semifinal. It was the first Rose Bowl ever to go to overtime and the highest-scoring Rose Bowl in history.
summary: Georgia beat Oklahoma 54-48 in double OT in the Jan. 1, 2018 Rose Bowl playoff semifinal, the first overtime Rose Bowl and the highest-scoring in its history.
body: Baker Mayfield's final college game became one of the wildest in playoff history. Second-ranked Oklahoma met third-ranked Georgia in Pasadena on New Year's Day 2018, with a trip to the national championship game on the line.

The Sooners came out flying. Mayfield even caught a 2-yard touchdown pass on a trick play with six seconds left in the first half, giving OU a 31-14 lead. Georgia's Rodrigo Blankenship trimmed it with a 55-yard field goal, a Rose Bowl record, as the half expired. Oklahoma running back Rodney Anderson finished with 201 rushing yards and two touchdowns.

Georgia stormed back behind Nick Chubb and Sony Michel. After Steven Parker returned a Michel fumble 46 yards for a touchdown to put OU back in front, Chubb tied the game on a 2-yard run with 55 seconds left in regulation. The teams traded field goals in the first overtime. In the second, Lorenzo Carter got a hand on Austin Seibert's 27-yard attempt, and Michel raced 27 yards for the winning touchdown on the next play. He finished with 181 yards and three scores on just 11 carries.

The records piled up. It was the first overtime game in Rose Bowl history, and the 102 combined points topped the 101 scored by USC and Penn State a year earlier. Georgia's 17-point rally was also the biggest comeback the Rose Bowl had seen. Mayfield closed his OU career with 287 passing yards and two touchdown passes.
